body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Samsung presented its Bluetooth-enabled portable media players ‘P2’ and ‘T10’ with the latest in-demand features through firmware upgrades during the press conference at CES 2008.
The initial upgrade will allow for Bluetooth file transfer between the P2 or T10 and compatible Bluetooth-enable devices, as well as pairing the P2 with compatible Bluetooth-enabled cell phones.
With Blue Wave, Samsung offers a value-enhancing activity for consumers to take advantage of even after the sale. Blue Wave upgrades are available at www.mpfreedom.com.
